words.translation: The earthy scent produced when rain falls on dry soil
words.sentence1: The air was filled with petrichor after the summer storm. (The air was filled with the scent of rain after the summer storm.)
words.sentence2: She stepped outside to enjoy the sweet petrichor. (She stepped outside to enjoy the sweet scent of rain on dry earth.)

words.translation: A place where one feels safe and at home
words.sentence1: Este rincón del jardín es mi querencia. (This corner of the garden is my safe place.)
words.sentence2: El escritor encontró su querencia en un pequeño pueblo costero. (The writer found his sanctuary in a small coastal town.)

words.translation: Ephemeral; lasting for a very short time
words.sentence1: La beauté des fleurs de cerisier est éphémère. (The beauty of cherry blossoms is ephemeral.)
words.sentence2: Ils ont partagé un instant d'un bonheur éphémère. (They shared a moment of fleeting happiness.)

words.translation: The feeling of being alone in the woods and connected to nature
words.sentence1: Ich suche oft die Waldeinsamkeit, um dem Lärm der Stadt zu entfliehen. (I often seek the solitude of the forest to escape the noise of the city.)
words.sentence2: Die Waldeinsamkeit schenkte ihr inneren Frieden. (The solitude of the forest gave her inner peace.)

words.sentence1: 森を歩いていると、美しい木漏れ日が見えた。 (While walking through the forest, I saw beautiful sunlight filtering through the trees.)
words.sentence2: 木漏れ日が彼女の顔を優しく照らした。 (The sunlight filtering through the trees gently illuminated her face.)

words.translation: A certain nonchalance, so as to conceal all art and make whatever one does or says appear to be without effort
words.sentence1: Lui indossa quel vecchio cappotto con una naturale sprezzatura. (He wears that old coat with a natural, effortless elegance.)
words.sentence2: La sua arte esprime una straordinaria sprezzatura. (His art expresses an extraordinary effortless grace.)

words.translation: The binding force or fate that brings people together
words.sentence1: 我们能在这里相遇，真是奇妙的缘分。 (Our meeting here is truly a wonderful twist of fate.)
words.sentence2: 有些事情只能看缘分，不能强求。 (Some things can only depend on fate; they cannot be forced.)

words.translation: Sunlight or moonlight rippling on the water
words.sentence1: 바다 위에 비치는 윤슬이 아름답습니다. (The sunlight rippling on the surface of the sea is beautiful.)
words.sentence2: 그녀는 강물에 반짝이는 윤슬을 바라보았다. (She gazed at the sparkling ripples of moonlight on the river.)

words.word: Moneasanka (មនោសញ្ចេតនា)
words.sentence1: ពួកគេមានមនោសញ្ចេតនាយ៉ាងជ្រាលជ្រៅចំពោះគ្នា។ (They have deep emotional feelings for each other.)
words.sentence2: សៀវភៅនេះដាស់មនោសញ្ចេតនាយ៉ាងខ្លាំង។ (This book awakens strong emotional feelings.)

words.sentence1: Dit is heerlik snoesig voor die kaggel op 'n koue winterswand. (It is wonderfully cozy in front of the fireplace on a cold winter night.)
words.sentence2: Sy het haar in 'n snoesige kombers toegedraai. (She wrapped herself in a cozy blanket.)
